result.decision: retain one generic scanner-convolved RGB NPS/ACF signature candidate and reject stock-associated profile fitting on this source
result.reason: fixed-crop and within-label shapes are highly repeatable and the group-level classifier is statistically non-random, but the preregistered effect-size control fails: within-minus-cross similarity is 0.00364 against the frozen 0.03 minimum. Infrared separation is also weak, and one uploader/scanner plus unknown roll/process/profile prevents emulsion attribution.

forbidden_rescue: lower the frozen within-minus-cross effect-size threshold
select or replace crops after reviewing dust and scratches
add a classifier or neural capacity to amplify the small label difference
interpret scanner-code NPS as physical grain size or emulsion identity
fit separate Ektar100 and UltraMax400 product profiles from these scans
claim_ceiling: Same-scanner observable code-domain NPS/ACF feasibility and one generic scanner-convolved signature candidate only; not emulsion truth, physical grain size/rate, process response, scanner-independent stock identity or product promotion.
